title: Revithia Chickpea Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew from Greece featuring chickpeas, revithia, and lovely smoky spices.
instructions: Heat the lovely oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the smoky paprika, greek oregano, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the revithia and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add the chickpeas and 4 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, until the revithia is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with additional smoky spices if desired.
